name: Paired evidence-shortlist SMC on the ExeDec DeepCoder filter-map debug subset (source-closure V2)

supersedes.reason: V1 omitted the import-time research package initializer and protocol loader from its explicit source closure; no benchmark execution or provider call occurred under V1.

source.adapter_subset: strict one-input Filter-then-Map subset; local label DeepCoder-HO is not an official ExeDec split

design.pairing: Within each task/seed block, both arms share start, provider, proposal-sampling, and resampling seeds; grammar-random additionally has a frozen shortlist seed.
design.seed_selection: mechanical consecutive seed IDs and task-index offsets, frozen without provider outcomes

proposal.llm_smc: four typed LLM local-repair slots totalized without retry or backfill
proposal.grammar_random: four unique non-no-op local repairs sampled without replacement from the recursive grammar
proposal.probability_source: application-computed exact mixture probability; the LLM supplies no confidence

primary_analysis.endpoint: at least one of the 29 executed complete programs is exact on every stored private debug semantic probe
primary_analysis.estimand: LLM-SMC minus grammar-random hidden-semantic success fraction
primary_analysis.test: exact two-sided conditional sign test on discordant paired blocks; ties excluded
primary_analysis.interpretation: descriptive debug-only; no confirmatory alpha or generalization claim

secondary_analysis: arm-specific hidden-semantic success and Wilson interval
first hidden-semantic success slot conditional on success
provider calls and physical scorer calls
self-normalized public exact-mass and mean-loss error against finite exhaustive reference

custody.runner_private_oracle_policy: runner never opens an oracle; preflight command must contain no private path
custody.analyzer_policy: validate all 64 public run artifacts before opening any of the four bound private debug oracles
custody.oracle_scope: provider-private debug probes over public released targets; not secret and not confirmatory

claim_limits: Released ExeDec tasks and targets are public and may occur in model training data.
The adapter subset is not an official ExeDec split or full DeepCoder implementation.
The current typed target collapses a two-line source program into one filter-map skeleton and does not reproduce ExeDec execution decomposition.
Finite private debug probes do not prove arbitrary-program semantic equivalence.
Eight seeds per task and four deduplicated targets give low statistical power.
Equal logical slots do not imply equal wall time, provider compute, or total compute.
No provider, success, SMC advantage, external-generalization, or speedup result exists at freeze time.
